source.name: 青岛日报社/观海新闻 (Qingdao Daily / dailyqd.com): 百年匠心致敬绿茵，崂山可乐携手青岛海牛足球俱乐部共启2026新赛季
source.quote: 青岛崂山矿泉水有限公司与俱乐部正式签署赞助协议，旗下“崂山”品牌将成为球队新赛季官方赞助商，“崂山可乐”将出现在海牛队新赛季主客场球衣胸前
source.note: Translation: 'Qingdao Laoshan Mineral Water Co., Ltd. formally signed the sponsorship agreement; its Laoshan brand will be the team's official sponsor, and Laoshan Cola will appear on the front of the team's home and away shirts this season.'

source.name: 网易 (NetEase, 易瞰青岛): 青岛信仰·青春力量 青岛海牛足球俱乐部2026赛季出征仪式圆满举行
source.quote: 青岛啤酒股份有限公司的崂山啤酒将继续为球队球衣的臂章广告
source.note: Translation: 'Tsingtao Brewery Co., Ltd.'s Laoshan Beer will continue as the team's shirt sleeve-badge (臂章) advertisement.' Same arrangement reported by Sohu and by Dongqiudi's reprint of the club's own announcement.

source.name: 懂球帝 (Dongqiudi): 青岛海牛2026赛季主场球衣：主色调亮橙色，辅以深蓝色点缀
source.quote: 近期，俱乐部将开售主场球衣耐克球迷服和出场夹克，请球迷朋友留意官方消息
source.note: Kit maker, not a shirt-sponsor placement; listed as partner per the convention for kit suppliers. Translation: 'Shortly, the club will start selling the Nike fan version of the home shirt and the match-day jacket' — from the club's own launch text, quoted by Dongqiudi; the same post carries Nike's own description of the kit ('耐克官方介绍到').

summary: Nike home kit (orange with deep blue, launched 28 Jan 2026). Laoshan Cola (Qingdao Beverage Group) debuted as front sponsor and Laoshan Beer (Tsingtao Brewery) continues as sleeve badge, per the club's 4 March 2026 season-launch ceremony. Back of shirt and shorts sponsors not documented in the available sources, so the list is not marked complete. Qingdao Bank and Qingdao Rural Commercial Bank are club strategic partners with no stated shirt placement.
